headline: A clean log on every USB plug, tidier kernel updates, a memory watch

items.title: Quiet USB plugging
items.text: Plugging or unplugging the USB cable no longer logs a power-chip error.

items.title: Tidier kernel updates
items.text: A kernel update now removes old drivers nothing can boot, and keeps the ones a rollback still needs.

items.title: A memory watch
items.text: The Q records how much memory each service holds over weeks, so a slow leak shows who it is.
